baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distributive construction كُلُّ نَفْسٍ and the causal/accounting link بِمَا كَسَبَتْ to رَهِينَةٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality distributes the rule person by person; acquisition generates a claim, and the living self becomes the security retained against that claim.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness make the collateral rule distributive and exceptionless at the focus-only stage.
The living soul-self identifies the whole accountable subject rather than a detachable possession.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies the accrued value or liability against which the self is held.
Security held for a right supplies the legal-economic mechanism of retention until a claim is answered.

changed_reading.before: A general statement that everyone is responsible for deeds.
changed_reading.after: A person-by-person collateral account: each living self is retained as security for the claim produced by its own acquisition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linkage of كَسَبَتْ to the predicative رَهِينَةٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: What the self accumulates does not remain external property; it feeds back into the self and fixes its very identity in an enduring condition.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself makes the self, not merely its estate, the locus altered by acquisition.
Obtained gain supplies the accretion that returns upon its acquirer.
Standing fixed and enduring converts accumulated action into a settled condition.

changed_reading.before: The self is temporarily detained because of an external record.
changed_reading.after: Acquisition hardens into the self's own enduring condition: what it gets becomes what fixes it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of كُلُّ, كَسَبَتْ, and رَهِينَةٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pursuit of gain functions like a wager in which the stake is not merely the gain but the entirety of the acquiring self.

activation_trace.role: Completeness makes the stake encompass the whole self.
The pursuit and capture of benefit supplies the wager's sought return.
Wager and risk stake recast the self as what is put at hazard by its gains.

changed_reading.after: Every pursuit of gain hazards the whole pursuer; the self itself is the stake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes possession from morally valid earning: granted wealth is followed by appetite for more, while favor-giving aimed at increase burdens its recipient. Kasb therefore records the direction and intention of exchange, so apparent gain can accrue as liability.

activation_trace.role: Inner mind and hidden intent anchor the valuation of an outward transfer in its inward aim.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the economic image whose moral sign the context reverses.
Held security turns improperly sought surplus into a claim against the seeker.
Burdening a beneficiary with one's favor shows how nominal giving can impose a counter-claim.
Numerical increase supplies the surplus sought through the prohibited favor.
Possessing abundant wealth supplies the granted stock that is mistaken for self-generated gain.
Seeking increase makes endless surplus-seeking the narrated response to already extended wealth.

structural_cues: 74:6 couples favor-giving with seeking more in a prohibition.
74:12-15 orders granted wealth before the recipient's appetite for further increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prohibited favor-for-increase exchange and a recipient of granted wealth who wants more; I infer that kasb evaluates intention and transfer direction, turning extractive gain into debt. A live alternative is that these are separate ethical examples and kasb remains an unqualified term for deeds.

changed_reading.before: Whatever benefit a self acquires is simply entered as its gain.
changed_reading.after: The account distinguishes gift from extraction: wealth possessed or increase secured through burdening others can be the very liability for which the self is held.

context_deltas.mechanism: A staged sequence of inward turning, calculated sizing, and voiced attribution manufactures a verdict. The sequence makes cognition and classification productive acts: the speaker earns the binding result he formulates.

activation_trace.role: Inner thought anchors the focus self as an active workshop of accountability.
Obtaining a result allows a deliberately produced judgment to count as an acquisition.
Security held for a claim makes the manufactured verdict bind its maker.
The heart's repeated turning supplies the first productive stage of the verdict.
Planning by estimation and inspection supplies deliberate shaping rather than accidental speech.
Producing speech externalizes the calculated judgment into an accountable act.
Transmission until a report becomes received supplies the content of the speaker's dismissive attribution.

structural_cues: 74:18-24 narrates thought, estimation, repeated condemnation, looking, bodily reaction, turning away, and finally speech.
The repeated ثُمَّ marks a produced sequence rather than an instantaneous opinion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the staged deliberation and its spoken verdict; I infer that this production is one concrete content of what the self 'earned.' A live alternative is that the episode illustrates culpability without narrowing or expanding kasb semantically.

changed_reading.before: Kasb primarily evokes overt deeds or material gain.
changed_reading.after: A self also acquires the judgments it deliberately fabricates: thought, calibration, and public classification become binding output.

context_deltas.mechanism: One numbered sign functions as an assay applied to different interiors. It yields settled knowledge in some and agitated doubt in diseased hearts in others, so encounter and response produce divergent acquisitions that become settled in the self.

activation_trace.role: Inner mind and hidden intent provide the interior in which the common sign is processed.
Obtaining an outcome lets interpretive response register as something acquired.
Fixity and endurance make the response a settled condition rather than a passing reaction.
Testing metal or persons supplies the assay mechanism by which one datum reveals differing interiors.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies one product of the assay.
Agitated suspicion supplies the opposed product of the same encounter.
The heart supplies the named interior location in which the divergent response forms.
Departure from health and balance supplies the condition that bends the test toward doubt.
The propounded comparison supplies the sign-form whose reception becomes diagnostic.

structural_cues: 74:31 explicitly gives multiple effects of the same count: certainty, increased faith, no doubt, and skeptical questioning.
The verse locates one skeptical response in hearts marked by illness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one test-sign and divergent interior outcomes; I infer that the response produced by interpreting the sign enters 'what it earned' and then fixes the self. A live alternative is that the outcomes merely reveal prior states rather than adding to them.

changed_reading.before: The self arrives with a pre-existing ledger of independent acts.
changed_reading.after: The self's ledger also grows through encounters: the same sign can be acquired as settled knowledge or as agitated doubt, and that response becomes part of its condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Voluntary forward or backward movement is followed by collateral fixation and then an exception identified by companionship and right-side placement. Rahina thus mediates between chosen trajectory and assigned status, while the exception prevents 'every' from becoming a closed ontology.

activation_trace.role: Totality establishes the broad rule against which the following exception has force.
Held security supplies the status reached between movement and exception.
Fixity makes the sharp contrast with the immediately preceding freedom to advance or delay.
Advancing forward supplies one chosen trajectory entering the focus rule.
Deferral to a later point supplies the opposed chosen trajectory.
Companionship and abiding association make the exception a relational category, not an isolated trait.
The right hand or right side supplies the category's marked placement.

structural_cues: 74:37-39 forms a tight sequence: advance or delay, every self pledged, except the companions of the right.
إِلَّا immediately limits the preceding universal formulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies free directional language, then fixation, then a marked exception; I infer a trajectory-to-status mechanism and a possible release category. The live grammatical alternative is whether the exception negates being pledged altogether or only a particular adverse mode of pledge.

changed_reading.before: Every self is intrinsically and uniformly a hostage.
changed_reading.after: Pledgedness is a consequence-bearing status reached from chosen direction, and the next verse opens a relationally marked exception to its adverse force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The retrospective confession fills kasb with failures to transfer sustenance, immersion in collective discourse, and denial of accounting. When the account matures, adding another person as advocate yields no benefit, sharpening the pledge as personal and non-transferable.

activation_trace.role: Gain-seeking is inverted so withheld benefit and harmful participation also accrue to the actor.
Security held for a right supplies the personal claim that later assistance cannot satisfy.
Feeding another supplies the omitted outward transfer named in the confession.
The humiliation of poverty identifies the vulnerable recipient toward whom the omitted duty ran.
Entering discourse or an affair supplies socially shared participation rather than solitary action.
Attributing falsehood supplies the active denial that joins omission in the account.
Accounting and recompense make the denied day the maturity point of the pledge.
Benefit as the opposite of harm marks the explicitly failed effect of outside aid.
An advocate joining another supplies the attempted interpersonal addition that cannot discharge the personal account.

structural_cues: 74:42-47 answers a retrospective question with repeated first-person plural omissions and participations.
74:48 immediately states that the intercessors' intercession does not benefit them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the confession list and the failure of joined advocacy; I infer that the list concretizes 'what it earned' and that failed pairing exposes non-transferability. A live alternative is that the list explains entry into Saqar without defining the scope or mechanics of kasb and rahn.

changed_reading.before: Earning consists mainly of positive acts, and another party might later offset the balance.
changed_reading.after: Omitted care and collective participation also accrue, while the matured pledge remains personally answerable when an added advocate brings no benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated universal quantifier narrows into each individual demanding an opened written sheet. Juxtaposed with the focus, the self's acquisition can function as its already individualized instrument: the record that both identifies the person and secures the claim.

activation_trace.role: The very self anchors the identity between accountable person and individualized record.
Held security supplies the binding legal function assigned to the record analogy.
Repeated totality distributes the desire for documentation to every individual just as the focus distributes pledgedness.
The individual person supplies the one-to-one granularity of the demanded document.
A written sheet supplies the documentary medium for the account.
Published writing supplies the demand that each sheet be individually opened and manifest.

structural_cues: 74:52 repeats كُلُّ and pairs it with ٱمْرِئٍ and individually given صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً.
The demand follows the account, exception, interrogation, and confession sequence of 74:38-48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated distributive language and a demand for individualized open writings; I infer a documentary analogy in which acquired acts already serve as each self's binding instrument. A live alternative is that 74:52 concerns demanded revelation alone and has no documentary relation to rahina.

changed_reading.before: The pledge is an abstract status backed by an unseen ledger.
changed_reading.after: Each self's acquisition behaves like its individualized binding document: the person asks for an external sheet while already carrying the instrument that secures the claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close of the surah conditions the act of recollection on divine willing and places protective restraint beside forgiveness that shields a wrongdoer from an act's effect. This weakens a mechanically closed reading of acquisition and collateral without erasing personal accountability.

activation_trace.role: The living self remains the accountable subject whose outcome may nonetheless be protected.
Held security supplies the claim whose apparently automatic closure is being qualified.
Bringing something back to presence supplies the responsive act offered to whoever wills.
Willing directed toward an object supplies the stated condition above human recollection.
Placing the self in protection supplies a live route other than remaining exposed to harm.
Covering a wrong and protecting its owner from its effect supplies the possible interruption of adverse consequence.

structural_cues: 74:54-56 moves from reminder, to human willing, to divine willing as the condition of recollection.
The surah closes by pairing worthiness of protective restraint with worthiness of forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditioned recollection and branch images of protection and forgiveness; I infer that the pledge system is not an autonomous causal machine and can admit protective covering. A live alternative is that the closing attributes orient conduct without specifying release from rahn.

changed_reading.before: Acquisition closes a self-caused mechanism in which pledgedness follows automatically and irreversibly.
changed_reading.after: Acquisition remains personally consequential, but recollection is enabled rather than autonomous and forgiveness leaves adverse effects protectively coverable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dawn-opening branch of ن ف س is form-distant from the ordinary noun 'self.' It remains anchored in the focus's نَفْس and is activated by the immediately preceding morning's unveiling; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary disclosure image, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَفْسٍ read through its opening-like-breath branch, while رَهِينَةٌ keeps the disclosed self fixed before view.

activation_trace.role: Opening or spreading like breath links the self imagistically to the preceding dawn.
Standing fixed makes what dawn opens remain exposed rather than pass unnoticed.
The first light of day supplies the concrete opening scene.
Removing a cover supplies the directional movement from hidden accumulation to disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents only a juridical detention of an already visible self.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory image, the dawn opens each self into visibility and its acquisitions are what hold that disclosed self fixed before view.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet does not explicitly say that flight causes pledgedness; the causal reversal is reader-supplied. It remains validly anchored in the focus contrast between acquired action and fixed rahn, activated by the later flight scene; downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic irony rather than a direct explanation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَسَبَتْ as acquired conduct and رَهِينَةٌ as standing fixed.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition allows evasive conduct to return as an outcome belonging to the runner.
Fixity and duration provide the ironic endpoint opposed to frantic escape.
Drawing away and distancing supplies the initial recoil from the reminder.
Flight and escape intensify recoil into overt evasive motion.
The pursuing force supplies the pressure under which attempted escape accelerates.

changed_reading.before: Pledgedness is a static legal image unrelated to the surah's later movement.
changed_reading.after: As a kinetic irony, recoil and flight cannot unfasten the self; evasive motion returns as the acquired path into fixation.

strongest_changes: The favor, wealth, and increase sequence makes kasb intention-sensitive: apparent gain can become a claim against the acquirer.
The deliberation episode and the test-sign expand earning to manufactured judgments and to responses produced through interpretation.
The 74:37-48 sequence turns rahina into a trajectory-dependent, exception-bearing, personally answerable status that includes omissions and social participation.
The closing protection and forgiveness language weakens any mechanically closed or necessarily irreversible account of pledgedness.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah order repeatedly reverses motion into fixation and gain into liability, while the later exception, failed interpersonal addition, individualized writings, and forgiveness keep the collateral image socially and legally dynamic rather than merely punitive.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammatical reach of the exception in 74:39 remains open: it may remove pledgedness itself or only its adverse realization.
The individualized-document reading of 74:52 is a contextual analogy, not an explicit identification of deeds with sheets.
The close names forgiveness but does not explicitly state how it alters the pledge mechanism.
The dawn-disclosure and flight-to-fixation readings remain deliberately branch-distant outliers.
